name: Toy Scanner
description: Recommends the nearest matching display with room, and pins a carried part's other half exactly, not just to its aisle.

name: Sorting Trolley
description: Wheel three toys instead of one. Aim at a toy and tap ACT to load it, then tap CARRY to cycle what you are holding.

name: Grippy Sneakers
description: Cross the shop floor a third faster without skidding into a display.

name: Long-Handled Grabber
description: Reach further into a pile, so a toy no longer has to be underfoot to pick up.

name: Manager's Nod
description: Stops the next twenty-five wrong placements before you let go. They still count as mistakes, but waste no slot or time.
